levels.surface: عبد القدوس بن محمد بن عبد الكبير بن شعيب بن الحبحاب

notes: Three «وعن» co-transmitters under Ibn Ajlan are read as one level; «عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة» is written once after them, and the sources differ on which route reaches Abu Salih
The Prophet is the end; the chain ends at Abu Hurayra
